'''Messo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who served as an aide to the Republic [[Unidentified CIS spy senator|Senator]] and a spy for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
After he failed to deliver a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]]s with key Republic strategies to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] because of the intervention of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], he traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], where he delivered the [[Datacard/Legends|data disk]] to another CIS [[Agent/Legends|agent]], [[San Maxus]]. Shortly afterward, he was tracked by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and he fell from a ledge and was hit by an oncoming [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]], which [[Death/Legends|killed]] him instantly.
